video_description: Foundational multi-joint dynamic mobility routine preparing heart rate, synovial fluid circulation, and neural readiness for home training.
instructions: Arm circles forward and backward for 30 seconds to lubricate shoulder capsules.
Torso twists with neutral spine to mobilise thoracic rotational range.
Gentle hip openers and dynamic hamstring sweeps with controlled cadence.
Light marching in place to elevate core body temperature.
form_cues: Breathe rhythmically throughout each dynamic movement.
Never bounce aggressively into end ranges of motion.
Keep ribs down and core lightly engaged.

video_description: Elevated-hands pressing progression reducing shear stress on shoulders while teaching full torso rigidity and chest contraction.
instructions: Place palms on a sturdy elevated surface slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Step feet back until torso forms a straight line from crown of head to heels.
Lower chest smoothly toward the edge while keeping elbows at a 45-degree angle.
Drive through palms to press back up without hyper-extending the lower back.
form_cues: Squeeze glutes and brace core to prevent hip sagging.
Keep neck neutral with eyes focused slightly ahead.
Control the 2-second eccentric descent.

video_description: Zero-equipment lower-body movement pattern developing knee flexion, glute recruitment, and bilateral stability.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes turned outward 15 to 20 degrees.
Hinge at hips and bend knees simultaneously, sitting back and down.
Descend until thighs reach parallel with the floor while keeping chest tall.
Drive through mid-foot to stand up, engaging glutes at top.
form_cues: Keep knees tracking over second and third toes.
Maintain whole-foot ground contact (heels do not lift).
Keep chest upright and eyes forward.

video_description: Targeted spinal flexion tutorial isolating the rectus abdominis without cervical neck strain.
instructions: Lie supine with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart.
Place fingertips gently behind ears without pulling on the neck.
Curl shoulder blades 2 to 3 inches off the mat by contracting abdominals.
Pause briefly at peak contraction, then lower down with control.
form_cues: Imagine holding an apple between chin and chest to prevent neck strain.
Exhale forcefully on the upward flexion phase.
Do not yank with arms; initiate entirely from the core.

video_description: Cross-body rotational movement targeting internal and external obliques and deep anterior core stabilizers.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with knees at 90 degrees and hands supporting the head.
Rotate right elbow across to meet left knee while extending the right leg out straight.
Alternate smoothly, bringing left elbow to right knee in a controlled cycling tempo.
Maintain continuous abdominal tension throughout the set.
form_cues: Rotate from the ribcage, not just the elbows.
Keep lower back pressed against the mat.
Move with deliberate tempo rather than speed.

video_description: Anti-extension isometric core hold building endurance in the transverse abdominis, serratus anterior, and pelvic floor.
instructions: Set forearms on the floor with elbows directly under shoulders.
Extend legs back with toes tucked, creating a continuous straight line.
Draw navel toward spine and squeeze glutes firmly.
Hold the position while maintaining steady diaphragmatic breathing.
form_cues: Do not allow hips to sag or pike into an A-frame.
Actively push the floor away to prevent shoulder winging.
Keep neck neutral with gaze down between forearms.

video_description: Low-impact aerobic base conditioning and active recovery promoting cardiovascular health and calorie expenditure.
instructions: Maintain tall posture with shoulders relaxed down and back.
Step with heel-to-toe roll pattern and natural arm swing.
Maintain a brisk, purposeful pace allowing deep nasal or rhythmic breathing.
Keep stride length natural without over-reaching.
form_cues: Look forward toward the horizon.
Engage lower abdominals slightly for pelvis stability.
Land lightly with mid-heel strike.

video_description: Foundational multi-joint dynamic mobility routine preparing heart rate, synovial fluid circulation, and neural readiness for home training.
instructions: Arm circles, torso rotations, hip openers, and active marches for 3 to 5 minutes.
form_cues: Move with controlled cadence through full active range of motion.

video_description: Full-body horizontal pushing baseline developing pectoralis major, anterior deltoids, and triceps with complete floor depth.
instructions: Hands slightly wider than shoulder-width, fingers spread, body in a rigid plank.
Lower chest with control until 2 inches from floor, elbows at 45 degrees.
Press through palms back to starting lockout with braced core.
form_cues: Maintain locked glutes and braced core throughout.
No elbow flaring past 45 degrees.
Touch chest down smoothly without bouncing.

video_description: Zero-equipment lower-body movement pattern developing knee flexion, glute recruitment, and bilateral stability.
instructions: Stand shoulder-width apart, descend past parallel with upright chest, and drive up smoothly.
form_cues: Track knees over toes, maintain heel contact throughout.

video_description: Strict abdominal flexion training emphasizing peak contraction and slow eccentric control.
instructions: Lie supine with feet anchored or flat, flex upper spine bringing ribs toward pelvis.
Hold peak contraction for 1 second, then lower under control.
form_cues: Breathe out all air at top contraction.
Keep hands light behind head without neck pull.

video_description: Lower-abdominal focused movement initiating flexion from the pelvis toward the ribcage.
instructions: Lie on back with knees bent at 90 degrees and arms by your sides for support.
Contract lower abs to curl hips off the mat bringing knees toward chest.
Lower hips slowly back to starting position without arching lower back.
form_cues: Initiate with abdominal pull, not leg momentum.
Control the lowering phase completely.

video_description: Extended lever abdominal exercise strengthening hip flexors and deep lower core musculature.
instructions: Lie flat with legs extended and hands placed under glutes or beside hips.
Keep legs straight and raise them together until perpendicular to the floor.
Lower legs slowly until heels hover 2 inches above the ground, then repeat.
form_cues: Do not allow lower back to peel off the floor at the bottom.
Keep knees as straight as mobility permits.

video_description: Decompressed spinal hanging movement challenging grip strength and vertical core flexion.
instructions: Grip a pull-up bar with overhand grip and hang with arms fully extended.
Engage lats and tuck pelvis, lifting knees up toward chest.
Lower knees with control without swinging your body back and forth.
form_cues: Eliminate swing momentum by pausing at the bottom dead hang.
Roll pelvis up slightly at the top for full abdominal contraction.

video_description: Cross-body rotational movement targeting internal and external obliques and deep anterior core stabilizers.
instructions: Alternate elbow-to-opposite-knee rotations with extended contralateral leg.
form_cues: Rotate from the torso, keep movement continuous and strict.

video_description: High-cadence plank-based movement combining shoulder stability, hip flexion, and metabolic conditioning.
instructions: Start in a tall push-up plank position with hands beneath shoulders.
Drive right knee in toward chest without letting hips bounce up.
Quickly switch legs, driving left knee forward as right leg extends back.
Maintain a smooth, rhythmic running cadence while keeping hips level.
form_cues: Keep shoulders stacked directly over wrists.
Do not pike hips high into the air.
Maintain neutral head position.

video_description: Anti-extension isometric core hold building endurance in the transverse abdominis, serratus anterior, and pelvic floor.
instructions: Forearm plank with tight glutes, engaged quads, and active shoulder push.
form_cues: Rigid body bridge, deep diaphragmatic breaths.

form_cues: Maintain steady cadence and upright torso.

form_cues: Zero hip swinging; maximum pelvic tilt control.
